trust_decision.summary: Caller-supplied avatar options (typed as numbers but never validated by the library API) are trusted to be safe for direct interpolation into SVG attribute text; core escapes string options (colors) but not rotate, and the initials style escapes fontFamily/textColor/initials but not fontSize/fontWeight.

landing_point.why: Summary leads with 'unescaped rotate option in @dicebear/core'; addRotate is the only place rotate is written into the SVG (called from packages/@dicebear/core/src/core.ts:46).

fix_sites.entry_point: public API createAvatar(initials, { fontSize | fontWeight }) via style.create (packages/@dicebear/core/src/core.ts:15)
fix_sites.module_kind: separate style plugin package with its own escape helper

O2_out_of_scope_site.where: packages/@dicebear/initials/src/index.ts:38 (style plugin composed into createAvatar at packages/@dicebear/core/src/core.ts:15; uses its own copy packages/@dicebear/initials/src/utils/escape.ts:1-8)

O3_reason_to_dismiss: fontSize/fontWeight live in a separate style package whose other values are already escaped and whose schema restricts them to integers/enum (packages/@dicebear/initials/src/schema.ts:61-77), so a solver fixing 'rotate in core' can call the style out of scope — but the advisory summary names it explicitly, which removes most of that lever.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: Valid numeric values must render unchanged: rotate(90, …) and font-size="42"; dy is computed arithmetically from fontSize next to the sink, so a fix that rejects/stringifies fontSize before the dy calculation, or clamps/throws on values, can change output.

O6_input_shapes: string payload passed for a number-typed option (rotate)
any non-string (array/object) via template-literal coercion `${value}` before escape (fix.diff:14, fix.diff:67)

O7_producer.where: Options are merged by a JSON copy in packages/@dicebear/core/src/utils/options.ts:30-43 with no type validation; the integer schema (packages/@dicebear/core/src/schema.ts:14-19) is only enforced by the CLI (packages/dicebear/src/utils/validateInputBySchema.ts:9-19)

O8b_injection_room.sibling: backgroundRotation written raw into gradientTransform; today it is numeric only because core.ts:23-30 routes it through prng.integer
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: A maintainer could plausibly switch to prng.pick(options.backgroundRotation) to pick a listed angle, which would pass a caller value straight into the unescaped attribute.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: scale interpolated into transform; numeric today only because it is divided by 100
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: Emitting `scale(${scale}%)`-style or passing the raw option for a CSS-like unit is an easy refactor.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: per-component rotation/offsetX/offsetY interpolated raw into transform (same generated code in glass, rings, thumbs)
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: Values are numeric only because of prng.integer at lines 42-53; a generator change to pass a fixed option value through would be a far-away, figma-generated second implementation of the same sink.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: size written into attributes (currently escaped by createAttrString at packages/@dicebear/core/src/utils/svg.ts:106-114)
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: A body-level width/height wrapper built by string template instead of attributes would bypass createAttrString.

O9_family: XSS / SVG markup injection via unescaped option values (CWE-79, CWE-184 incomplete list of escaped options)

O10_build.toolchain: Node >=18, npm workspaces, tsc build per package, node --test
O10_build.project_tests: packages/@dicebear/core/tests/create.test.js and packages/@dicebear/initials/tests/create.test.js exist; tests run against built lib/ (fix.diff:24,78) so a tsc build is required before testing

j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Escape rotate in addRotate (or coerce with Number()) and stop, missing fontSize/fontWeight in the separate initials package.

out_of_scope_notes: apps/editor and apps/docs build avatars as consumers of createAvatar; not inspected beyond file listing.
packages/@dicebear/converter/src/utils/svg.ts:8-18 round-trips SVG with processEntities:false; unrelated to this protection.
unverified: repo_mb unknown: shell disabled, size not measured; tiny_repo/giant_repo not assessed (34 style packages with large generated component files suggest >5 MB).

O8 judged empty after reading every ${…} interpolation in packages/@dicebear/core/src and the style index/pickComponent/hooks files: remaining values (scale, translateX/Y, radius, backgroundRotation, viewBox numbers, component rotation/offsets) are always produced by arithmetic or prng.integer and so are numbers; not exhaustively checked inside every generated component file beyond the color-escape pattern sampled.

j_defence_ineffective set 0: the integer schema exists (packages/@dicebear/core/src/schema.ts:14-19, packages/@dicebear/initials/src/schema.ts:61-77) but the library API never applies it, so it is absent rather than ineffective at this route.
